title: Uttho Rasool Abid e Bimaar Aaye Hain
body:
Deen e rasoole pak ki khatir aseer they
Qaide sitam mein waris e shah e amir
They barchi ki zad pe aaye hai hum shakle mustafa
Teer e sitam ki zad pe bhi sheh ke sageer they
Uttho rasool Abid e bimaar aaye hain
1. Ek darsgah e sabr o reza hai yeh Karbala
Shabbir ban mein ek naya kaba banaye hai n
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shaam me ghariba aaye to duniya badal gayi
Durr e bhi dekho pusht pe zalim ke khaye hain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Be gooro be kafan raha laasha Hussain ka
Turbat tumhare laal ki nana banaye hain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Masnad tumhari jal gayi jhoola bhi jal gaya
Khaimoo mein aag asqiya nana lagaye hain
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Pehchaan payi duniya na aale rasool ko
Aale nabi ko ahle sitam yun sataye hain
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Abid gharib khafeela salar e ahle bait
Turbat pe nana jaan ki nouha sunaye hain
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Iqbal ab madine mein kohraam hai bapa
Roodad e gham rasool ko Abid sunaye hain
Azz.... Iqbal Abedi.
